messages:
mara: Quick flag: I hit a parity bug between sync and async Python SDK error handling.

mara: Sync raises RedwoodHTTPError with parsed JSON and raw bytes; async surfaces a generic HTTPError and raw_bytes is None.

mara: Repro payload: {"error":{"code":"validation_failed","msg":"missing field: prompt"}}

josh: Likely our async transport calls resp.text()/resp.json() for logging and doesn't keep the raw bytes.

lenora: Also saw typing mismatch: async stubs declare Exception, so users can't catch RedwoodHTTPError.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-789 assigned to @dennis: "async: preserve raw body + unify exception types".

dennis: Plan: stash response bytes before parsing, attach raw_bytes, parsed_body, status_code, request_id to RedwoodHTTPError, export exception from package, update .pyi stubs, add regression tests for both transports.

josh: Add request_id to exception for correlation and improve __str__ to include status/code.

mara: I'll add a short SDK sample showing how to inspect parsed_body vs raw_bytes.

ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/314 by @dennis (tests + stubs).
